name: Summit AZ - City Pages Index
body:
> Index · Summit Az · 2026-10-16

# Summary
Index of all city page and service page work for Summit AZ. The site has 122 local pages (12 services x 10 cities, plus extras) built on one Elementor template family. On Sep 24 the not-indexed cause was traced to duplication with sister-city pages, not thinness, so the rewrites since then replace city-swap copy with sourced local facts, one page at a time, text only inside existing widgets.

# Rewrite timeline
| Date | Pages | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Sep 24 to 25 | Water pressure Phoenix; drain Scottsdale, Queen Creek, Tempe; fixture Queen Creek; garbage disposal Phoenix and Fountain Hills; water heater Phoenix; faucet and toilet; shower and bath | Not-indexed and city-swap pages |
| Sep 26 | Leak detection STV, QC, AJ; water pressure Scottsdale; pipe lining Mesa; sewer Mesa; tankless QC; water heater QC | Low-hanging-fruit plan |
| Oct 3 | Drain Fountain Hills; sewer Fountain Hills and Queen Creek; pipe lining claim fixes | Striking-distance batch |
| Oct 7 | 7 not-indexed pages: links, schema, PRV retarget | Crawl path boost |
| Oct 9 | Fixture Gilbert, Tempe, Apache Junction | After Guardian review |
| Oct 16 | /plumbing/ hub to "residential plumbing services" | Hub retarget |
